headline: China's slow purchases of US agricultural goods test $17 billion trade commitment
summary: Slow buying of US agricultural commodities by China is putting a $17 billion bilateral trade commitment under pressure.
why: Agricultural flows between the US and China serve as a key barometer for bilateral trade relations and set price sentiment for global grain and oilseed futures.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: US farm exporters face lower demand as China lags behind the $17 billion trade commitment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
